title: Markdown export Level of Detail: research and proposals
state: Research only. No switches below are implemented or approved.
recommendation: Keep today's detailed default. Start with independent tool-input and tool-result controls, readable reasoning, question/answer handling and per-tool overrides. Extend only after reviewing real exports.
principles: MCP calls are tool calls. Do not render a call twice because both selectors match.
Separate content selection, detail level, collapse state and companion-file inclusion.
None, short, medium and complete describe content detail, not whole-export profiles.
Complete means all supported recorded content for that category, not raw-source completeness.
Use recorded invocation descriptions or deterministic arguments. Do not add a summarizing model call.
Keep call identity, order, status, errors, cancellation and exclusion counts intelligible at reduced detail.
Classify by recorded provenance and payload first. Tool-name matching is a fallback and must be labelled.
Do not infer missing history, fetch current instruction files, dereference remote attachments or decrypt opaque reasoning.
Redaction and privacy are independent. Hiding an inline block while retaining its companion does not remove its data.
Unknown new types still need drift reporting. An exclusion rule must not silence an unsupported format.

controls.recommendation: Keep unchanged
controls.benefit: Existing exports and automation keep their meaning.
controls.risk: Do not relabel today's export as lossless or claim pending fidelity flags exist.

controls.recommendation: Keep as core content in the first phase
controls.benefit: A reader can follow the conversation.
controls.risk: System-initiated requests and hidden turns need separate classification. Do not remove instructions embedded in ordinary user text by pattern.

controls.values: All; include exact tools; exclude exact tools
controls.recommendation: Support exact stable identity, with unknown names reported
controls.benefit: User chooses specific noisy tools.
controls.risk: Aliases and renamed tools can make a rule stop matching. Report unmatched selectors.

controls.recommendation: Independent of result detail
controls.benefit: Calls can remain understandable without pages of arguments.
controls.risk: Input can include code, full delegated prompts, paths or credentials. Redact before extracting excerpts.

controls.recommendation: Independent of input detail
controls.benefit: Covers all calls with no results and compact-result requests.
controls.risk: An empty result is not the same as a deliberately excluded result or missing source.

controls.recommendation: One canonical rule per tool
controls.benefit: File reads can be short while failures and edits stay complete.
controls.risk: Do not introduce a full rule language before simpler selectors prove insufficient.

controls.values: All; MCP only; non-MCP only; per recorded server/tool
controls.recommendation: MCP as subset, not second output stream
controls.benefit: Covers MCP-only calls with or without responses.
controls.risk: A name prefix does not prove MCP transport. Origin can be missing or serialized differently.

controls.values: Recorded description plus identifying arguments and status
controls.recommendation: Deterministic short representation
controls.benefit: Matches requested one-line summaries.
controls.risk: Display descriptions can omit actual arguments. Label excerpted commands and never call them the full executed command.

controls.recommendation: Keep visible even when normal results are disabled
controls.benefit: A failed call cannot look successful.
controls.risk: Needs approval as a result-filter exception. Error messages may contain sensitive text.

controls.values: Current merge rules; future delta summary
controls.recommendation: Keep current identity/order rules
controls.benefit: Less duplicate status/output.
controls.risk: Never deduplicate by matching text alone or combine different call IDs.

controls.recommendation: Research separately from final results
controls.benefit: Reduces repeated command polling.
controls.risk: A late failure or new output can occur after an initial tool response.

controls.recommendation: Treat as a semantic role with exact-tool overrides
controls.benefit: Directly supports one-line reads and no reads.
controls.risk: Shell/MCP tools may also read files. Static command parsing cannot reliably classify arbitrary programs.

controls.recommendation: Separate queries from result bodies
controls.benefit: Search often dominates long exports.
controls.risk: Missing matches and zero matches must not be confused. Preserve whether a result was truncated upstream.

controls.recommendation: Keep distinct from file reads
controls.benefit: Shows changes without all patch text when desired.
controls.risk: A path list cannot reconstruct edits. Never generate old file contents from today's working tree.

controls.recommendation: Inventory accept/reject/undo separately
controls.benefit: Distinguishes proposed edits from accepted edits.
controls.risk: Recorded edit intent does not prove final disk contents or developer acceptance.

controls.recommendation: First phase: on/off, no invented summary
controls.benefit: Supports all/no reasoning.
controls.risk: A recorded model-written summary and a full thinking block are not equivalent. Keep source labels.

controls.recommendation: Never export opaque continuation tokens as readable thought
controls.benefit: Explains unavailable reasoning.
controls.risk: Cannot decrypt or reconstruct. Not a richer selectable detail level.

controls.values: Title + answer; question/options + answer; complete structured exchange
controls.recommendation: Dedicated category, not just another tool-result blob
controls.benefit: The short form can show the decision clearly.
controls.risk: Answers can be in tool results, question-carousel state, or later user turns. Preserve free text, skipped/cancelled and unanswered separately.

controls.values: Hide layout; keep options/selected labels/validation as available
controls.recommendation: Do not require UI decoration for readable answers
controls.benefit: Avoids noisy schemas.
controls.risk: MCP elicitation form data and a custom ask_user tool have different schemas.

controls.values: Delegation line; recorded result summary; complete verified nested conversation
controls.recommendation: Separate delegation input from child transcript detail
controls.benefit: Large child traces can be shortened selectively.
controls.risk: A returned summary is not a full transcript. Parent-child mapping must stay verified.

controls.recommendation: Default remains complete under current policy
controls.benefit: Helps explain a child's assignment.
controls.risk: Changing the current always-complete child-prompt rule needs approval.

controls.recommendation: Keep identity labels on any retained child output
controls.benefit: Reader knows which agent acted.
controls.risk: Do not assign parent usage, effort or model to a child without recorded attribution.

controls.values: Recorded references; excerpt; complete recorded content
controls.recommendation: Separate system/developer/project/user instructions where source distinguishes them
controls.benefit: Allows less instruction boilerplate.
controls.risk: Loaded instructions may be absent from persisted records. Do not read current files to claim historical content.

controls.values: Invocation/name only; recorded description; complete loaded content
controls.recommendation: Separate discovery, invocation and injected text
controls.benefit: Shows workflow choice without repeating long instructions.
controls.risk: Reading SKILL.md does not prove a runtime skill invocation. Custom-agent definitions can contain private text.

controls.values: Operation/title; recorded content; complete supported payload
controls.recommendation: Separate read/write/delete/vote from loaded context
controls.benefit: Explains memory influence and state-changing operations.
controls.risk: Graph lookup, saved Copilot memory, AGENTS.md and compaction are not one memory format. Never query current memory to reconstruct the past.

controls.recommendation: Separate attached content from assistant citations
controls.benefit: Documents input context.
controls.risk: Paths can be private. A link does not prove the bytes were recorded or are available now.

controls.recommendation: Keep boundary visible
controls.benefit: Explains a discontinuity in later replies.
controls.risk: A compaction summary is not the missing original conversation.

controls.values: Metadata/reference; linked bytes; future inline display
controls.recommendation: Keep current companion behavior as default
controls.benefit: Control large visual evidence independently.
controls.risk: Image pixels bypass text redaction. Binary inclusion and inline presentation are separate choices.

controls.recommendation: Inventory now; defer extraction beyond current policy
controls.benefit: Makes documented upstream types visible as future work.
controls.risk: Documented MCP audio support does not prove local persistence or exporter support. Do not decode arbitrary payloads by default.

controls.values: Resource identity; selected fields; complete recorded structured content
controls.recommendation: Keep content blocks, structuredContent and errors distinct
controls.benefit: Avoids flattening structured responses into unreadable text.
controls.risk: Resource links differ from embedded resources. Do not fetch a URI while exporting offline.

controls.recommendation: Keep complete by default
controls.benefit: Code and Mermaid often carry the main answer.
controls.risk: Naive line clipping breaks fences, indentation, tables and diagrams.

controls.values: None; labels/targets; complete recorded citation metadata
controls.recommendation: Keep source links with retained statements
controls.benefit: Maintains evidence behind an answer.
controls.risk: Removing citations can leave claims unsupported. Link safety/trust metadata is not prose.

controls.values: Plain summary; supported semantic rendering; recorded JSON fallback
controls.recommendation: Inventory trees, commands, plans, reviews and notebook edits separately
controls.benefit: Captures content beyond Markdown prose.
controls.risk: UI widgets can carry decisions. Generic JSON fallback is not the same as a semantic renderer.

controls.recommendation: Separate from LOD
controls.benefit: Less scrolling without losing content.
controls.risk: Collapsed Markdown is still present, searchable and potentially private.

controls.values: Current preview + full companion; future no companion for excluded content
controls.recommendation: Make exclusion apply to newly generated companion files too
controls.benefit: A smaller export bundle is actually smaller.
controls.risk: Leaving a hidden full companion defeats content exclusion. Do not delete earlier exports or caches.

controls.values: None; per-turn labels; complete supported records
controls.recommendation: Separate selected model from recorded answering model
controls.benefit: Explains routing and model changes.
controls.risk: Auto/Fusion records vary by version. Unrecorded effort must remain unknown.

controls.values: None; session summary; turn/agent detail; supported raw metadata
controls.recommendation: Keep source and coverage labels with any numbers
controls.benefit: Reduce cost tables independently.
controls.risk: Never add cumulative checkpoints, mix Local units with nano-AIU, or treat missing as zero.

controls.recommendation: Keep recorded timing distinct from export time
controls.benefit: Less turn-header noise.
controls.risk: Waiting, execution and wall-clock durations differ. Stable rendering needs an explicit context.

controls.recommendation: Do not offer a silent mode that removes accountability
controls.benefit: Readers know what lower LOD removed.
controls.risk: Counts need units: events, calls, text blocks, images and bytes are not interchangeable.

controls.values: Keep existing exclusions; optional future research
controls.recommendation: No inclusion change in the first phase
controls.benefit: Avoids reopening unrelated fidelity policy.
controls.risk: Can duplicate conversation or expose secrets. Documented events are not automatically export content.

controls.values: Default < global category < exact per-tool override; final exclusion wins within one resolved rule
controls.recommendation: Proposed ordering only; decide before implementation
controls.benefit: Many per-tool choices are easier to reuse than a long command.
controls.risk: Ambiguous include/exclude precedence can silently hide data. Reject contradictory rules rather than guessing.

examples.short: view: AGENTS.md, requested lines 1-100; completed; result excluded
examples.medium: Recorded invocation plus path/range and a bounded preview, labelled as an excerpt
examples.complete: All supported recorded input and result, with today's overflow companion policy

examples.short: search_graph: pattern *listing* in project C-_DEV-vsc-chat-tool; completed; result excluded
examples.medium: Pattern, project, filters and reported match/page counts, when actually recorded
examples.complete: All recorded query arguments and returned content, including coverage warnings

examples.short: powershell: Inspect both projects and existing changes; command excerpt: Get-ChildItem ...; exit 0
examples.medium: Recorded command, working directory, status and labelled output excerpt
examples.complete: Original/display commands where recorded, output/deltas, errors, exit code and duration

examples.short: ask_user: question title -> recorded selected label / free-text answer / skipped / unanswered
examples.medium: Question text, options and recorded answer, omitting layout metadata
examples.complete: Supported recorded form and response, with outcome and provenance

stages.work: Review examples, category inventory and default behavior. Decide whether errors override result exclusion.
stages.notApproved: No CLI syntax or code changes.

stages.work: Tool input/results, MCP selection, reasoning, questions and exact per-tool overrides, with exclusion accounting and saved-file verification.
stages.effort: Medium to large; estimate after tracing both renderers

stages.work: Semantic file/search roles, instructions/skills/memory, structured widgets, richer media and reusable configuration.
stages.notApproved: Do not bundle these into the first implementation.

openQuestions: When results are excluded, should errors still show a short message, or status only?
Should short and medium use fixed lines/bytes, category-specific fields, or user-set limits? No thresholds approved.
Does no file reads mean excluding returned file contents, hiding read calls, or both?
Which recorded fields establish MCP origin across Local and SDK sources?
Should excluded full content be absent from new companions, while frozen source captures remain independent diagnostics?
How should missing user answers and unsupported event types affect reduced-detail verification?
Which loaded instruction/memory/skill records actually survive in each source, and which are just references?
How should exact tool aliases, unmatched selectors and contradictory overrides be reported?
limitations: This is a bounded survey, not an exhaustive census of every Copilot installation or historical version.

Repository schema documentation includes older evidence and stale statements. For example, its provider section says SDK Markdown is not implemented, but the README documents implemented SDK export. It also mentions old 24 KiB clipping. These statements are not treated as current runtime evidence.
The knowledge graph reports metadata changes on the read documentation. Findings rely on direct reads, not graph completeness. No production call graph is claimed.
Cross-session history queries returned no rows for the requested recent window. The corpus survey uses read-only on-disk evidence instead.
Export self-checks and Layer D do not establish complete support for every documented upstream content type.
Report and examples may contain private paths or chat content. Keep the run local and review before sharing.
